description: This Java source file defines a Spring configuration class 'ClientRegistrationIdResolverConfiguration' that provides various strategies for resolving OAuth2 client registration IDs based on different profiles and scenarios. It includes nested configuration classes for specific profiles and methods for custom resolvers.

classes.name: ClientRegistrationIdResolverConfiguration
classes.description: Main configuration class providing different client registration ID resolvers based on profiles.

classes.name: ClientRegistrationIdResolverConfiguration.CurrentUserClientRegistrationIdResolverConfiguration
classes.description: Nested configuration class for 'current-user' profile, providing a resolver that gets the client registration ID from the current authenticated user.

classes.name: ClientRegistrationIdResolverConfiguration.CompositeClientRegistrationIdResolverConfiguration
classes.description: Nested configuration class for 'composite' profile, providing a resolver that tries multiple methods to resolve the client registration ID.

classes.name: ClientRegistrationIdResolverConfiguration.AuthenticationRequiredClientRegistrationIdResolverConfiguration
classes.description: Nested configuration class for 'authentication-required' profile, providing a resolver that requires user authentication.

methods.name: currentUserClientRegistrationIdResolver
methods.description: Creates a resolver that retrieves the client registration ID from the current OAuth2-authenticated user.

methods.name: compositeClientRegistrationIdResolver
methods.description: Creates a resolver that attempts multiple strategies to resolve the client registration ID, falling back to a default.

methods.name: authenticationRequiredClientRegistrationIdResolver
methods.description: Creates a resolver that enforces authentication before resolving the client registration ID.
